title: Database Server High CPU Usage - Performance Degradation
description: Dell PowerEdge R740 server experiencing sustained CPU usage above 90% for the past 3 hours. Application response times have increased from 200ms to 2-3 seconds. Multiple user complaints received. Critical alert triggered at 14:30. Requires immediate investigation to identify resource-intensive queries or processes.

title: Application Server Memory Leak Detected
description: HP ProLiant DL380 Gen10 showing gradual memory consumption increase. Started at 45% usage on Nov 14, now at 88%. Memory alert triggered. Backend services occasionally timing out. Assigned to senior operator for investigation. Suspect memory leak in one of the microservices. Monitoring logs and preparing restart plan.
resolution_notes: Investigation in progress. Identified suspect service (user-session-manager). Planning controlled restart during maintenance window tonight 22:00-23:00.

title: Network Router Firmware Update Required
description: Ubiquiti UniFi Dream Machine Pro flagged for critical firmware update (version 3.2.9 addresses security vulnerabilities). Device placed in maintenance status. Update scheduled and completed during maintenance window. Router rebooted successfully. All network services restored. Post-update verification completed - no connectivity issues detected.
resolution_notes: Firmware updated from v3.1.5 to v3.2.9 successfully. Update completed at 23:30, router rebooted at 23:35, all services online at 23:40. Post-update testing: ping tests OK, VPN tunnels re-established, WiFi clients reconnected automatically. No issues detected. Monitoring for 24 hours.

title: Printer Offline - Paper Jam Hardware Failure
description: Epson WorkForce Pro WF-C879R multifunction printer stuck offline. Initial diagnosis showed paper jam, but after clearing paper, device still non-functional. Paper feed mechanism appears damaged - rollers not engaging properly. Device marked as damaged. Contacted vendor for warranty repair. Estimated repair time 5-7 business days.
resolution_notes: Paper jam cleared but hardware failure confirmed. Paper feed mechanism damaged - rollers not gripping properly. Asset status updated to 'damaged'. Warranty claim submitted (Claim #WR-2024-11-001). Vendor confirmed in-warranty repair. Pickup scheduled for Nov 18. Users redirected to Floor 2 printer (asset-per-001) temporarily.

title: Core Switch Port Failure - Connectivity Loss
description: Cisco Catalyst 9300 Switch port Gi1/0/24 failed during morning operations. 15 workstations on Floor 3 lost network connectivity at 08:15. Users unable to access email, file shares, or internal applications. High-priority incident affecting productivity. Admin assigned immediately for diagnosis and port failover.
resolution_notes: Port Gi1/0/24 diagnosed as hardware failure (no link light, interface shows 'err-disabled'). Executed emergency failover: moved VLAN to spare port Gi1/0/48. 12 workstations reconnected. Remaining 3 require physical cable relocation - facilities team notified. Expected completion 16:00 today. Switch port marked for RMA.

title: Software License Expiration Warning - Office 365
description: Microsoft Office 365 Enterprise license (asset-sw-001) expires in 45 days on January 1, 2025. Automated alert triggered. 50 users affected if not renewed. Finance approval required for renewal. Must process before December 15 to avoid service interruption.
